title: A permission scoped to a single client grants realm-wide client management
description: hasPermission(String scope) doesn't check that the granting policy is bound to the all-clients resource, allowing a single-client permission to grant realm-wide access through DefaultPolicyEvaluator's resource-type-wide evaluation.

title: Dead code and unused imports in the new ClientPermissionsV2
description: getEvaluationContext() method is private and never called; logger field is unused; six imports (Scope, TOKEN_EXCHANGE, ClientModelIdentity, DefaultEvaluationContext, EvaluationContext) exist only for the dead method.

title: New javadoc describes two void methods as returning a boolean
description: requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() javadoc incorrectly claim they return boolean when they are void methods that throw ForbiddenException, misleading callers about the return type.

title: Clients resources have no display name in the permission UI
description: getResourceName() only handles USERS type; CLIENTS type falls through to resource.getDisplayName() which is never set, resulting in blank display names and raw UUIDs in the admin console instead of client IDs.
